tasks.description: The export button should be added to the sales report page. It should be visible and clickable when the page is loaded. The button should have a clear label indicating its purpose.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sales report page is loaded, when the user clicks the export button, then a download of the report is initiated.

tasks.description: Create a backend endpoint that generates the CSV for the requested report and streams the response to the client. This should be done in a way that memory usage stays bounded regardless of report size.
acceptance_criteria: Given a large report, when the export endpoint is called, then the response is streamed to the client without running out of memory.

tasks.description: The user should be able to choose which columns to include in the export before downloading. The generated CSV should include only the selected columns, in the displayed order.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sales report page is loaded, when the user selects specific columns, then only those columns are included in the exported CSV.

tasks.description: Encode the CSV per RFC 4180: quote fields containing commas, double quotes, or newlines, and escape embedded double quotes by doubling them.
acceptance_criteria: Given a report with special characters, when the CSV is generated, then the special characters are properly escaped according to RFC 4180.

tasks.description: The first row of the CSV should contain the human-readable column names for the selected columns.
acceptance_criteria: Given a report with selected columns, when the CSV is generated, then the first row contains the human-readable column names.

tasks.description: The export button should call the streaming export endpoint when clicked, passing the selected columns and report data.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sales report page is loaded, when the user clicks the export button, then the streaming export endpoint is called with the correct parameters.
